EC3: History of a chronic pain condition
EC4: History of severe mental illness (as their experience of symptoms may already be altered)
EC5: Current use of fibrates (because of the risk of interaction with statins but will not exclude participants taking ezetimibe).
EC6: Severe previous reaction or reaction considered immunological, such as anaphylaxis [OR], facial swelling, [OR] severe rash [OR], muscle ache  with rise in serum creatine kinase [OR], inflammatory myopathy [OR], rhabdomyolysis [OR] or liver function abnormalities (aspartate transaminase (AST) [OR] or alanine transaminase (ALT) greater than 3 times upper limit or normal).
EC7: Side-effects taking longer than 2 weeks to develop (because in such participants much longer blocks of treatment would be required, if the present study is positive such studies will be planned for the future)*.
EC8: History of statin [AND] intolerance with drug interaction to antiretroviral drugs.
EC9: History of statin [AND] intolerance to any other drug.
EC11: Side effects taking longer than 2 weeks to present.
EC12: In clinical judgement of study doctor, participant should not participate.
